project_type: React 18 + TypeScript drawing app (Excalidraw clone) with Supabase backend
build_system: Vite with @cloudflare/vite-plugin, deployed to Cloudflare Workers via wrangler
test_framework: Vitest with jsdom environment, @testing-library/react, setup in src/test/setup.ts
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install 2. Run npx tsc --noEmit for type checking 3. Run npx vitest run for tests
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - full network access. Supabase client requires env vars (VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY) which are not set - skip runtime tests that need Supabase. The cloudflare vite plugin may cause build issues without wrangler config.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode enabled, ESLint configured
key_patterns: Zustand store for canvas state, React hooks for data fetching (useScenes, useFolders), AuthContext for auth, RoughJS for rendering, canvas-based drawing with mouse event handlers in Editor.tsx, CSS variables for theming with dark/light mode
directory_structure: src/pages/ (Login, Signup, Dashboard, Editor), src/store/ (Zustand canvas store), src/hooks/ (useScenes, useFolders, useAutoSave), src/context/ (AuthContext), src/lib/ (supabase, canvasUtils, errorHandler, rateLimiter, validation), src/components/ (ErrorBoundary, KeyboardShortcutsModal), src/types/ (database types)
